# Pass 5 — The screen map

<!-- Generated by tools/ui-parity/screen-map.php from `php artisan route:list`.
     Do not edit by hand: re-run the script. -->

Item C1 of the mobile plan: every route, what renders it, and the app screen that has to
match. Generated, because a matrix this size kept by hand stops being true quickly — and
"full parity" is only a claim if something can check it.

**134 routes in all. 40 are screens the app has to build.** The rest are the admin panel, the API, support endpoints, non-GET actions, and 5 GET routes that answer with JSON rather than a view — those belong to the API workstream, not this one.

The JSON ones are worth naming, because they are the session-authenticated endpoints
the app cannot use and the API has to replace:

- `verification.verify` — `/email/verify/{id}/{hash}` (VerificationController@verify)
- `yard.connections.state` — `/yard/connections/state/{userId}` (YardController@connectionState)
- `yard.contacts.nickname.get` — `/yard/contacts/nickname/{userId}` (YardController@getNickname)
- `yard.user-preview` — `/yard/user-preview/{identifier}` (YardController@userPreview)
- `yard.users.search` — `/yard/users/search` (YardController@searchUsers)

## Where the routes go

| Area | Routes | In the app |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | 35 | **No** — web only, and it keeps steering the app through `/api/v1/configuration` |
| `marketplace` | 14 | Yes |
| `yard` | 14 | Yes |
| `auth` | 13 | Yes |
| `_framework` | 13 | No — Livewire, broadcasting and the health check |
| `_api` | 10 | It *is* the app's back end |
| `coming_soon` | 10 | Yes — one screen, ten slugs |
| `_support` | 9 | No — endpoints, not screens |
| `profile` | 8 | Yes |
| `pages` | 4 | Yes |
| `onboard` | 2 | Yes |
| `home` | 1 | Yes |
| `people` | 1 | Yes |

## The screens that are not routes

A route list cannot see these, and between them they are a large part of what the app
does. Each is an overlay opened by an event — see
[pass 1 §7](01-layout-navigation.md) for the nine mounted globally.

| Overlay | Opened by | Covered |
|---|---|---|
| App drawer | `open-app-menu` | [01](01-layout-navigation.md) |
| Discover modal | `open-discover` | — |
| Kamer AI chat | `open-kamer-ai` | — |
| User preview card | `open-user-preview` | [04](04-shared-components.md) |
| GoMarket chat dock | `open-gomarket-chat` | [03](03-gomarket.md) |
| Connection notifier | realtime | [04](04-shared-components.md) |
| Room info panel | `open-room-info` | [02](02-goconnect.md) |
| Message selection | long press | [02](02-goconnect.md) |
| Image lightbox | tap a photo | [04](04-shared-components.md) |
| Forward sheet | `open-forward` | [04](04-shared-components.md) |
| Communities modal | `open-communities` | — |
| Connections modal | `open-connections` | — |
| Starred messages | `open-starred` | — |
| Archived chats | `open-archived` | — |
| Call manager | realtime | — deferred with calls |
| Share to chat | `open-share` | — |
| Location switcher | the location strip | — |
| Listing item modal | `mp-open-listing` | [03](03-gomarket.md) |
| Toasts | `toast` / `yard-toast` | [04](04-shared-components.md) |
| PWA install banner | — | no app equivalent |

Twenty overlays against 40 routed screens. **The app's route
count is not its screen count**, and an overlay is where most of the interaction detail
in this product lives.
